thread:
Alex R (partnerships): Quick follow-up from today's sync with OpenModelX — they want to do a consignment-style distribution of their open weights via our marketplace + select HW partners. Need to align on licensing + redistribution guardrails before we proceed.
Maya S (ecosystems): Nice. Do we know which license they're proposing? Apache/mit-style or something with non-commercial clauses?
Alex R (partnerships): They said 'permissive' during call but asked if we can allow quantized redistributions and repackaging for edge partners. Also asked about co-branded announcements / joint press.
Samir K (legal): We need the exact license text. Permissive is broad — still want an addendum that: 1) grants Redwood rights to repackage/quantize for distribution 2) prohibits third-party re-licensing without written approval 3) includes export control and ORT language. Also need indemnity carve-outs.
Jordan P (product): From a runtime perspective: we can support quantized variants (8-bit/4-bit) but require model provenance tags and a model-card that lists training data + evals. Packaging should include a checksum and a small manifest, e.g.:
```
model_name: omx-3b
variant: q8_0
manifest_version: 1.0
sha256: <blob>
card: omx-3b-v1.2.md
```
Maya S (ecosystems): Agree on manifest. For HW partners we need a separate SKU flow — they expect a firmware-signed bundle and a different rev-share model. OpenModelX asked if we can do 70/30 marketplace, 85/15 HW partner direct (model owner gets larger % on edge sales). Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Samir K (legal): Revenue splits fine commercially but contractually we need to: - ensure we don't grant them rights to audit customer data - include a security liability cap - include explicit export compliance obligations (EAR/OFAC). Also confirm whether they allow commercial use (customers reselling apps).
Alex R (partnerships): They verbally allowed commercial usage, but want attribution and a logo usage guideline. Also asked for a 2-week embargo on announcements until both sides sign the distribution addendum. Proposed announcement target: 2026-05-10.
Jordan P (product): Can we support embargo? Yes, we can gate public listing until legal signals go-ahead. Ops: need a packaging checklist for HW bundles: signed firmware, quantized variant, manifest, model card, benchmark report (latency/cost).
Maya S (ecosystems): I'll own the marketplace listing spec + HW partner bundling doc. Action: I'll draft a spec and get OpenModelX to confirm their manifest fields.
Samir K (legal): I'll draft a short distribution addendum (grant + restrictions + export + indemnities + announcement embargo). Will ping legal ops for standard SLA clauses.
Alex R (partnerships): Great — plan: Samir draft by EOD Wednesday (2124850000-ish?), Maya draft listing spec by Friday, Jordan to prepare packaging checklist. We'll aim to sign and lock embargo by 2026-05-03 to hit announcement 2026-05-10.
EcosystemBot: Meeting scheduled: "OMX consignment + distro follow-up" on 2026-04-28 10:00 PST. @Maya S @Samir K @Jordan P @Alex R (partnerships) :calendar:
Maya S (ecosystems): One last ask from OMx — they want a small 'support-lite' channel for HW partner issues (not full SRE). We can offer a partner slack + curated runbook. Thoughts?
Jordan P (product): Support-lite is fine, put it in the partner SLA. We'll provide onboarding runbook and a triage flow.
Samir K (legal): Addendum should reference support-lite as a non-SLA service; avoid implying uptime guarantees.
Alex R (partnerships): OK. I'll summarize and send to OMx after Samir's draft. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Maya S (ecosystems): 👍 will start the spec and loop OpenModelX for manifest confirmation.
Samir K (legal): Will attach a small annex for export-control language (need to confirm training-data origins).
Jordan P (product): I'll mock the packaging repo and manifest validator early next week.
Alex R (partnerships): End of thread — will post follow-ups in the meeting notes channel.
